LanguageData.GJL_SG_ToggleDesc: Enable or disable the directional barrier.
LanguageData.GJL_SG_LockDesc: Keep the current shield direction while the mech moves or fires. Unlock to follow body rotation.
LanguageData.GJL_SG_RotateDesc: Turn the shield 90 degrees clockwise and lock its direction. The cyan line shown when selected is its blocking width.
